name: elian-workflow
description: DEPRECATED — install elian-store instead, which ships these two skills plus the rest of the workflow. Issue-cycle bookends that record engineering work history to Notion: open an issue and close it with a readable narrative of decisions, architecture, verification, and remaining checks. Workspace-agnostic — database ids and property names come from a local config the skill helps you create on first run. This plugin is kept so existing installs keep working; it receives no new skills.
